text_nodes.text: Hays County took up AI on three separate September agendas. No answer appears on them or in the county's minutes archive.
c1 c6 c11 c15 TEXAS AI DOCKET
First, a promise not to switch it on.
The September 1st agenda records what the sheriff's office committed to, and what would have to happen before that changes.
"Acknowledgement of the Hays County Sheriff's Office's commitment to not activate or implement Axon Draft One"
"an AI-enabled report-writing feature within the Axon AI Era platform"
AT THE FOOT OF THE ITEM
c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 TEXAS AI DOCKET
It drafts from what the camera heard.
The vendor's own page says the narrative is produced in seconds, and that one can't be submitted without an officer reviewing and approving it.
AXON, ON ITS OWN PRODUCT PAGE
Two weeks later, a request to buy one.
The county clerk's office asked the same court for a product whose maker says it writes official meeting minutes.
"write official meeting minutes from any source"
"authorize the County Clerk's Office to obtain AI Minutes through Govably, Inc."
AT THE FOOT OF THE ITEM
c6 c7 c8 c10 c18 TEXAS AI DOCKET
"authorize a waiver to the purchasing policy of obtaining three quotes"
County purchasing policy asks for three quotes. The item asks the court to set that aside for this one.
A week after September 1st, a policy put to the same court.

The September 8th agenda took up how the county governs AI in surveillance. The item listed straight after it is a Tyler Technologies amendment for report writing services. Nothing on the page joins the two.
c11 c12 c13 c14 TEXAS AI DOCKET
One county. One court. Three agendas.
The September 1st, September 8th and September 15th meetings were all the same commissioners court.
c1 c11 c6 TEXAS AI DOCKET
The newest minutes are dated July 28th.
The county's own Court Minutes 2026 archive lists newest first. Nothing later appears on it, so no disposition for any of the three September items is published there.
It has to come back to this court.
The commitment reaches any new AI feature the platform may later offer.
"any new AI-based features the Axon AI Era platform may make available under the related contract without returning to the Hays County Commissioners Court for approval"
Every source behind this deck is linked in the first comment.
